data.heading: Three generations of craftsmanship
data.description:
Aurum & Co. opened in T. Nagar in 1988. Three generations later, our karigars still hand-finish every piece, from delicate everyday chains to temple jewellery for weddings.

Every gold piece is BIS hallmarked, and we print the weight, purity and making charges on every invoice.

data.heading: Help & FAQ
data.subheading: Orders, delivery, payments and returns — answered.

items.question: Is all your gold hallmarked?
items.answer: Yes, every gold piece carries a BIS hallmark with HUID.

items.question: How is the price calculated?
items.answer: Gold rate on the day × weight, plus making charges and GST — all shown on the invoice.

items.question: Can I exchange old gold?
items.answer: Yes, at our store or by insured pickup in select cities.

items.question: Is delivery insured?
items.answer: Yes, every order is fully insured until delivery.

items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Insured delivery in 3–7 days; tamper-proof packaging.

data.heading: Shipping & Returns
data.subheading: How we deliver, and how returns work.

data.content:
Delivery

Insured delivery in 3–7 days; tamper-proof packaging.

  • Delivery is free on orders above ₹9,999; otherwise a flat ₹199 applies.
  • Cash on delivery is not available for this store.
  • You will receive tracking details by email and SMS once your order ships.

Returns

15-day returns on unworn pieces; lifetime exchange on gold.

To start a return, email hello@aurumco.example with your order number. Refunds are made to the original payment method within 5–7 working days of receiving the item.

This policy explains how Aurum & Co. collects and uses your information.

What we collect

When you order, we collect your name, email, phone number and delivery address so we can process and deliver your order. Payments are handled by our payment partner; we never see or store your card details.

How we use it

Only to fulfil your orders, send order updates and answer your questions. We do not sell your information.

Contact

For any privacy question, contact us using the details on the contact page.

By placing an order on this website you agree to these terms.

Orders and prices

All prices are in Indian rupees and include GST. An order is confirmed once payment is received or, for cash on delivery, once you receive a confirmation email.

Handmade products

Our products are handmade; small variations in colour, size and finish are not defects.

Returns

See our Shipping & Returns page.
